Hi all — quick legal summary after initial pass of the MSA and DPA. Key items: 

MSA (Quantify proposed changes):
- Indemnity: Quantify proposes unilateral vendor indemnity for IP claims. We will push for mutual indemnity and limit to direct damages; no broad consequential exclusions.
- Data security: Quantify wants narrow audit rights; propose a standard SOC2 evidence exchange clause and allow customer-managed audits under NDA only.
- Liability cap: request to keep damages capped to the greater of fees paid in 12 months or $1M; they propose uncapped for certain categories — pushback required.

DPA:
- Deletion window: they propose 90 days after termination; we prefer 30 days for ephemeral logs, 60 days for backups. Propose a 60-day window with explicit backup carveout and documented deletion process.
- Subprocessor list: require 10-day notice for adding new subprocessors (they propose 30 days).

SOW:
- Confirming Jonas' notes. Also we should make acceptance gating required for final payment (no auto-acceptance).

I will prepare a tracked redline of the MSA and a suggested DPA edit and upload by 11/24. If Quantify insists on their indemnity language we should prepare an alternate commercial concession (e.g., escrowed support credits or liability carveouts).

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
